title: Credible sets and posterior predictive distribution
title_html: Credible sets and posterior predictive distribution
html:
Let the prior be NIG(m0,V0,a0,b0), so that by @thm-opt-bayes-conjugate the posterior is NIG(mn,Vn,an,bn). Put ν=2an and τ2=bn/an.

  1. For 𝛌λ≠0, the interval 𝛌𝛌𝛌λ⊤mn ± tν,α/2τλ⊤Vnλ is the 1−α HPD credible interval for 𝛌𝛃λ⊤β; it is also equal-tailed.

  2. For a p×q matrix Λ of rank q, the set 𝛟𝛟𝛟{ϕ0: (ϕ0−Λ⊤mn)⊤(Λ⊤VnΛ)−1(ϕ0−Λ⊤mn)≤qτ2Fα(q,ν)} is the 1−α HPD credible region for 𝛃Λ⊤β.

  3. Let 𝛃𝛆Y0=X0β+ε0 be k future observations, with 𝛆ε0∼Nk(0,σ2Ik) independent of Y and of 𝛃β given σ2. The posterior predictive distribution of Y0 is Y0∣y ∼ tν(X0mn, τ2(Ik+X0VnX0⊤)). In particular, for one future observation at x0, the interval x0⊤mn±tν,α/2τ1+x0⊤Vnx0 has posterior predictive probability 1−α.

  4. [2bn/χα/22(ν), 2bn/χ1−α/22(ν)] is an equal-tailed 1−α credible interval for σ2.
